        ORG     #7000
START   LD      HL,TAB
        LD      A,(HL)
        LD      (TAB+1),A
        JR      NZ,START
        DB      1,2,"AB",#10
        DW      START,TAB
        LD      A,1+2*3
        LD      B,7/2
        LD      C,#1234
        LD      D,#1234
        LD      DE,#1234^
        EX      AF,AF'
        LD      (IX+5),A
        BIT     7,C
        OUT     (#FE),A
TAB     DB      5
VAL     EQU     3
        LD      A,VAL
        DS      3,"X"
        PUSH    AF,BC
